title: Background saves
help: After you sign out, this app keeps saving whole files to the folder you choose. Existing files are never replaced.
selection: Allow this app to save here after you sign out, until you revoke access.
needs: An administrator must approve background saves before you can choose a folder.
disabled: Background saves are disabled. An administrator can enable them; you must then select a destination again.
uncertainHelp: The result is unknown. Check this original job and the destination before taking further action. This app will not save it again automatically.
denied: Access was refused. Check your folder permissions, then select the destination again.
permission: You do not have permission to write to this folder. After the permission is restored, save again; you do not need to choose the folder again.
permissionSelect: You do not have permission to write to this folder, so it was not authorized. Choose another folder, or choose this one again after the permission is restored.
missing: The destination folder no longer exists. Move it back to save there again, or choose another destination.
appPrivilege: DSM Application Privileges do not allow this app from this address. Ask an administrator to change the rule, or save again from an allowed address.
appPrivilegeSelect: DSM Application Privileges do not allow this app from this address. Ask an administrator to change the rule, or choose the folder again from an allowed address.
session: Sign in to DSM again, then refresh.
conflict: A file with this name already exists. Check the destination and choose another name for a new job.
space: There is not enough space. Check the destination before starting a new job.
error: The action could not be confirmed. Refresh to check the current result before taking further action.
reselect: The allowed scope changed. Choose your save folder again. Saved files remain.
exampleHelp: Save a small example file to your active destination with your own permissions.
changeHelp: Changing the save folder requires your user password and clears every user’s destination. Saved files remain.
approveHelp: Users can choose where to save only inside this folder.
